svg.title: This local identity makes the replicated root seminorm exactly zero. Fix a coarse reporting level k. Eventually a fine-scale chamber contains the common marking neighborhood strictly inside it, because the ratio of fine to reporting spacing tends to zero. Tile the fine torus by the prescribed chambers and put one translated copy of the insertion in each chamber. Keep the distinguished copy in chamber zero, and multiply all other copies to form the spectator. Distinct chamber interiors keep that spectator outside the marking neighborhood. Its measurability and boundedness follow from the local insertion bounds on the compact finite configuration space. The marking identity then gives Y Eβ fa = 0. chambers a
